notes: I couldn't open SAM.gov itself, because the page is JavaScript-only and returns nothing. The mirrors govcontractfinder.com and govsignals.ai worked. I found three US federal notices from 2025–26 for single-system NovaSeq 6000 service. All three are one-year, sole-source awards to Illumina, and none states a value. They show some federal labs still paying to keep a 6000 running into 2026–27. But each covers only one instrument and is a short renewal, so the evidence is weak and doesn't show a multi-year commitment. Two more search hits (govcontractfinder's 75N98026Q01014 and sweetspotgov) came from snippets and were not fully read. I used 3 tool calls and 2 fetches out of the 15-fetch cap.
how_to_mine: Search govcontractfinder.com, oversight.govsignals.ai and console.sweetspotgov.com for 'NovaSeq 6000' with terms such as 'Silver', 'Bronze' and 'Gold support', 'S4', 'sole source Illumina' and 'service agreement'. Cover FY2025–26. For each notice, record the agency, posted date, serial number, term and any award value. Check award notices on USAspending.gov (no login) by searching the Illumina recipient plus 'NovaSeq' to get actual dollar values. Then count the notices per year and compare 2024, 2025 and 2026. Also search for NovaSeq X service notices ('NovaSeq X Plus service agreement sole source') to see whether labs are moving to the X. The Loren Data SAM Daily archives for 2024 offer a baseline.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: A Navy lab opened a sole-source one-year Silver Support plan for a NovaSeq 6000 in Dec 2025, so some federal labs are still renewing 6000 service.
items.detail: Naval Medical Research Center (Silver Spring, MD) posted notice N3239826Q4072 on 22 Dec 2025. It is a sole-source intent with Illumina for a one-year support plan on one NovaSeq 6000 (serial A01716), listed as four line items. The response deadline is 31 Dec 2026 and no value is shown. This is one instrument and a one-year term, so it shows continued use but not a multi-year commitment.
items.why_new: The exclusion list has no federal SAM.gov 6000 service renewals.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: The NCI at NIH planned a sole-source preventive-maintenance contract for a government-owned NovaSeq 6000 in Aug 2026, so federal labs are still servicing 6000s.
items.detail: Notice 75N98026Q01014 is a presolicitation posted 14 Aug 2026, with responses due 24 Aug 2026. It names NCI (Bethesda, MD), one NovaSeq 6000 (serial A01064) and a firm-fixed-price award under FAR 6.302-1. Term and value are not shown on the mirror. A search snippet also showed NIEHS notice 75N96025Q00037 for a Nova 6000 Bronze Service Agreement running 29 Jun 2025 to 28 Jun 2026. That is a one-year term that has now lapsed, and I did not confirm whether it was renewed.
items.why_new: This is new procurement evidence that NIH institutes are still renewing 6000 service as of Aug 2026.
